title: Salaami khalq mai mehshar bapaa hai
body:
Salaami khalq mai mehshar bapaa hai
Wafaat-e-hazrat-e-Khairunnisa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yehi aathi hai har chakki sey awaaz
Batool-e-paak fakhrey Aasiya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Malak aathay nahin bey izn ghar mai
Yeh qadr-e-Ahlebaith-e-Mustafa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Payambar ko jo rothi thi shab-o-roz
Isi ko aaj kunbaa ro raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha Hyder sey Zehra ney yeh rokar
Kay saath apna tumhaara choot-tha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri doh betiyaan hain aur doh betay hain
Yateemi ka har ek ko saamnaa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Gareebaan chaak hain Sibtain-e-Ahmad
Sar-e-Hyder pa koh-e-Gham giraa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali ki betiyaan sar peet-thi hai
Janaaza ghar sey Zehra ka chalaa hai
